function_v0.doc: Immediate upgrade of the factory itself.
function_v0.name: upgrade

function_v0.doc:
Step 1 of 2 (Soroban allows 100 ledger entries per transaction): validates the config, deploys the
receipt-vault and its own jump-rate model and initializes both. The market is not usable until
`activate_market` wires it into the controller. A non-`None` yield route is attached later by
`attach_yield`.
function_v0.name: add_market

function_v0.doc: Once per group: deploys the reward distributor for `reward_token` and registers it as the\ncontroller's reward token. The choice is permanent for the group.
function_v0.name: set_rewards

function_v0.doc: Caps, reserve factor and a CF change. Caps and reserve factor apply immediately; a CF change\nis staged on the controller and applied by `apply_pending` after 60s.
function_v0.name: update_risk

function_v0.doc: Attaches the market's configured yield route. DeFindex is attached directly (no adapter);\nreturns the adapter address for routes that deploy one.
function_v0.name: attach_yield

function_v0.doc: Deploys the group controller and price router and wires the router as the controller's oracle\n(the first oracle set on a fresh controller applies immediately).
function_v0.name: create_group

function_v0.doc: Pauses (or unpauses) deposits and borrows. The core controller auto-expires a pause after 72h.
function_v0.name: pause_market

function_v0.doc: Switching yield route detaches the old route and attaches the new one. Phase 4.
function_v0.name: switch_yield

function_v0.doc: Stages a new price source for the market; `apply_pending` applies it after 60s.
function_v0.name: update_price

function_v0.doc: Deploys nothing: updates the market's existing jump-rate model (immediate in core).
function_v0.name: update_rates

function_v0.doc: Applies staged changes once their 60s delay passed: the CF on the controller (second call of\n`set_market_cf`) and the price config on the router. `None` applies every market of the group.
function_v0.name: apply_pending

function_v0.doc: Step 2 of 2: configures the vault, lists it on the controller, sets the price source and the\ncollateral factor (the first CF for a market applies immediately), reward speeds and idle buffer.
function_v0.name: activate_market

function_v0.doc: Phase 2+: records the mode. Wiring `set_keeper` on vaults lands with the Aquarius route.
function_v0.name: set_keeper_mode

function_v0.doc: Core receipt-vault upgrades require redeem to be paused. Peridot admin only, used around `execute_core_upgrade`.
function_v0.name: set_redeem_pause

function_v0.doc: Only Reflector feeds that Peridot has reviewed can be used as a price source.
function_v0.name: set_oracle_allowed

function_v0.doc: Step 2, after the delay.
function_v0.name: execute_core_upgrade

function_v0.doc: Core contracts keep their two-step path (60s delay in the hackathon copy): step 1.
function_v0.name: propose_core_upgrade

function_v0.doc: Withdrawing can leave accrued rewards unclaimable until the distributor is refunded.
function_v0.name: withdraw_unallocated

function_v0.doc: Approves one (token, oracle, asset key) price mapping. Owners can only choose mappings approved here.
function_v0.name: set_price_feed_allowed

function_v0.doc: Hotfix pass-through for NEW group contracts (price router, distributor, adapters): immediate.
function_v0.name: upgrade_group_contract

function_v0.doc: Only yield vaults that Peridot has reviewed can receive a market's idle liquidity: an arbitrary\nvault supplied by a group owner could take the depositors' funds.
function_v0.name: set_yield_vault_allowed

event_v0.doc: `param` is a short name ("cf", "supply_cap", "borrow_cap", "reserve_factor", "rates",\n"idle_buffer", "pause_deposit", "pause_borrow", "liq_incentive", "liq_fee", ...); values are\nthe decimal numbers as u128 (booleans as 0/1).
event_v0.name: ParamUpdated

udt_struct_v0.doc: Everything the factory remembers about a market beyond the group's `markets` list.
udt_struct_v0.name: MarketRecord

fields.doc: Adapter contract deployed by the factory for the yield route (None for DeFindex or no route).
fields.name: adapter

fields.doc: Applied configuration (`collateral_factor` is the value live on the controller).
fields.name: cfg

fields.doc: At most one staged CF change (a Vec because optional structs do not round-trip in SDK test builds).
fields.name: pending_cf

fields.doc: At most one staged price change.
fields.name: pending_price

udt_struct_v0.doc: 6.4 Interest curve in core `jump-rate-model` units. All zeros is valid (0% borrow).
udt_struct_v0.name: RateModel

udt_struct_v0.doc: Wasm hashes the factory deploys with `deploy_v2`. Phase 1 fields are required,\nlater phases are optional until their contracts exist.
udt_struct_v0.name: WasmHashes

fields.doc: Reward token base units per second; 0 if no rewards.
fields.name: supply_reward_per_sec

udt_union_v0.doc: 6.2 Per-token price derivation mode of the group price router.
udt_union_v0.name: PriceConfig

udt_struct_v0.doc: 6.2 Payloads of [`PriceConfig`]. `#[contracttype]` enums allow only unit and tuple\nvariants, so the named fields of the handoff sketch live in these structs.
udt_struct_v0.name: ReflectorOnlyCfg

udt_union_v0.doc: Copied byte for byte from core `simple-peridottroller/src/reflector.rs`.\nThe `contracttype` layout must match what the controller decodes.
udt_union_v0.name: Asset
